## Demographics

```{r setup-demographics, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}
if (file.exists("_quarto.yml")) here::i_am("scan-calculations/demographics_charts.qmd")
if (!exists("aoi")) source(here::here("core/R/setup.R"))
```

```{r data-loading-demographics, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}
# Read demographic CSV (output of Python demographic_aggregate)
age_file <- list.files(tabular_dir, full.names = TRUE) %>% str_subset(".*_demographics?\\.csv")
has_age_data <- length(age_file) > 0

if (has_age_data) {
  pop_dist_group_wp <- read_csv(age_file[1], show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    select(Age_Bracket = age_group, Sex = sex, Count = population) %>%
    mutate(Age_Bracket = as.factor(Age_Bracket), Sex = as.factor(Sex)) %>%
    mutate(Sex = fct_recode(Sex, "Female" = "f", "Male" = "m")) %>%
    mutate(Age_Bracket = forcats::fct_collapse(Age_Bracket, "0-4" = c("0-1", "1-4"))) %>%
    mutate(Age_Bracket = factor(Age_Bracket, levels = c("0-4", "5-9", "10-14", "15-19", "20-24", "25-29", "30-34", "35-39", "40-44", "45-49", "50-54", "55-59", "60-64", "65-69", "70-74", "75-79", "80+"))) %>%
    group_by(Age_Bracket, Sex) %>% summarize(Count = sum(Count), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(Percentage = Count/sum(Count)) %>%
    group_by(Sex) %>%
    mutate(
      Sexed_Percent = Count/sum(Count),
      Sexed_Percent_cum = cumsum(Sexed_Percent)) %>%
    ungroup()
}
```

### Age-Sex Distribution

```{r age-sex-plot, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#| label: chart-age-sex-distribution
#| results: asis

if (has_age_data) {
  pop_age_sex_plot <- ggplot(pop_dist_group_wp, aes(x = Age_Bracket, y = Percentage, fill = Sex)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge") +
    labs(title = paste("Population distribution in", city, "by sex"),
         y = "Percentage", x = "Age Bracket", fill = "") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          legend.key.height = unit(1/8, "in"),
          axis.line = element_line(linewidth = .5, color = "black"),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linewidth = .125, color = "dark gray"),
          panel.grid.minor.y = element_line(linewidth = .125, linetype = 2, color = "dark gray")
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, .2, .01),
                       labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                       limits = c(0, ceiling(max(pop_dist_group_wp$Percentage) * 100) /100),
                       expand = c(0,0))

  ggsave(here("03-render-output", "plots", "world-pop-age-sex.png"), plot = pop_age_sex_plot, device = "png",
         width = 8, height = 6.84, units = "in", dpi = "print")
  print(pop_age_sex_plot)
  cat("\n\n")

  print_paged_df(pop_dist_group_wp)
}
```

### Age Distribution

```{r age-distribution-table, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#| label: chart-age-distribution
#| results: asis

if (has_age_data) {
  pop_dist_group_wp %>% group_by(Age_Bracket) %>%
    summarize(Percentage = sum(Percentage)) %>%
    mutate(cumpct = cumsum(Percentage)) %>%
    print_paged_df()
}
```

### Demographic Indicators

```{r demographic-stats, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#| label: demographic-indicators
#| results: asis

if (has_age_data) {
  under5 <- pop_dist_group_wp %>%
    filter(Age_Bracket %in% c("0-4")) %>% summarize(across(c(Count, Percentage), sum))
  under25 <- pop_dist_group_wp %>%
    filter(Age_Bracket %in% c("0-4", "5-9", "10-14", "15-19", "20-24")) %>% summarize(across(c(Count, Percentage), sum))
  youth <- pop_dist_group_wp %>%
    filter(Age_Bracket %in% c("15-19", "20-24")) %>% summarize(across(c(Count, Percentage), sum))
  working_age <- pop_dist_group_wp %>%
    filter(Age_Bracket %in% c("15-19", "20-24", "25-29", "30-34", "35-39", "40-44", "45-49", "50-54", "55-59", "60-64")) %>% summarize(across(c(Count, Percentage), sum))
  elderly <- pop_dist_group_wp %>%
    filter(Age_Bracket %in% c("60-64", "65-69", "70-74", "75-79", "80+")) %>% summarize(across(c(Count, Percentage), sum))
  sex_totals <-  pop_dist_group_wp %>%
    group_by(Sex) %>% summarize(across(c(Count, Percentage), sum))
  female_pct <- sex_totals[which(sex_totals$Sex == "Female"), 3]
  sex_ratio <- (1 - female_pct) / female_pct * 100
  reproductive_age <-  pop_dist_group_wp %>%
    filter(Sex == "Female", Age_Bracket %in% c("15-19", "20-24", "25-29", "30-34", "35-39", "40-44", "45-49")) %>% summarize(across(c(Count, Sexed_Percent), sum))

  print_text(paste("Children under 5 years old:", under5$Percentage %>% {scales::label_percent()(.)}))
  print_text(paste("Population under 25 years old:", under25$Percentage %>% {scales::label_percent()(.)}))
  print_text(paste("Youth (15–24 years old):", youth$Percentage %>% {scales::label_percent()(.)}))
  print_text(paste("Working-age population (15–64 years old):", working_age$Percentage %>% {scales::label_percent()(.)}))
  print_text(paste("Elderly population (60 years and older):", elderly$Percentage %>% {scales::label_percent()(.)}))
  print_text(paste("Women of reproductive age (15–50 years old):", reproductive_age$Sexed_Percent %>% {scales::label_percent()(.)}))
  print_text(paste("Sex ratio:", round(sex_ratio, 2), "males to 100 females"))

  cat("\n\n---\n\n")

  under25_pct  <- scales::label_percent()(under25$Percentage)
  working_pct  <- scales::label_percent()(working_age$Percentage)
  elderly_pct  <- scales::label_percent()(elderly$Percentage)
  repro_pct    <- scales::label_percent()(reproductive_age$Sexed_Percent)

  print_text(glue("{paste_bold(city)} has a relatively young population, with approximately {paste_bold(under25_pct)} under the age of 25 and {paste_bold(working_pct)} of working age."))
  print_text(glue("Only {paste_bold(elderly_pct)} of the population is 60 or older."))
  print_text(glue("{paste_bold(repro_pct)} of all females in {paste_bold(city)} are of reproductive age."))
}
```
